verification_results.reason: Astra R1 rejected the prior exact head. The six findings were corrected and the TASK-0004 module now contains 68 deterministic offline tests. Existing repository regressions run on the PR head but still do not execute the TASK-0004 module; Astra R2 must run it locally on the new exact head.

review_focus: Astra R1 six-finding correction verification on exact correction head
current OpenAI SIWC endpoint and dynamic_agent_client registration semantics
callback-issued client_id persistence before token exchange and reuse for returning sign-in
stable urn:uuid ext_agent_host_id and exact 127.0.0.1 /auth/callback loopback URI
PKCE S256, fresh state/nonce, strict callback state/client binding
mandatory cryptographic ID-token JWKS signature verification plus exact issuer/audience/nonce/expiry/subject checks
required chatgpt.tokens.use.direct and offline_access scope enforcement
DPAPI-protected token storage, atomic persistence, separate profile registrations and credential-free status output
serialized rotating refresh, optional retained ID token/scope on refresh, and invalid_grant/revocation error mapping
account model catalog visible-slug parsing and exact gpt-6-astra-only enforcement
stateless Responses request shape store=false/stream=true and blocked unsupported stateful fields
stream completion and plan/auth/infrastructure error handling before TASK-0003 handoff
TASK-0003 immutable snapshot/schema/idempotency gates remain mandatory
no OPENAI_API_KEY/client-secret/paid fallback/conversation access/local inference/cleanup mutation/merge or auto-merge
private-key/auth-code/id_token_hint/bearer/token diagnostics are redacted; invalid refresh grants fail closed
live streamed reviewer transport is impossible unless a separate activation policy sets reviewer_enabled=true and zero_extra_spend_confirmed=true
exact gpt-6-astra catalog and required plan scopes are rechecked immediately before live reviewer transport
non-Bearer token responses are rejected and expired profiles refresh even if earliest_refresh_at is stale/future
single production live-review pipeline must refresh session, query account-bound catalog, validate fresh account-bound zero-spend allowance, execute TASK-0003 evaluation/schema/dedup, and fail closed
returning sign-in uses separate registration metadata plus profile-version CAS so concurrent refresh cannot be rolled back
refresh response validation blocks invalid token values/types/lifetimes and never retries a consumed rotating token
FileLock releases process mutex/handles on every acquisition failure and uses bounded nonblocking Windows lock attempts
public diagnostics use structured safe statuses and multiline credential continuations are redacted
known_limitations: The user has not performed real browser authorization yet; that is intentionally post-merge.
The live Windows verifier requires PyJWT[crypto] at runtime for JWKS signature verification; CI tests use an injected fake verifier.
TASK-0004 does not enable the self-hosted reviewer workflow or automatic inference. A separate activation gate is required.
OpenAI plan usage can be subject to account usage/credit settings; automatic reviewer inference must remain disabled until the later activation gate confirms the user's zero-extra-spend controls.

recovery.failure_reason: Controller validated, committed and pushed candidate branch successfully; repository Actions policy blocked GitHub Actions from creating the pull request. Draft PR #6 was recovered through the trusted GitHub connector.

findings: R1-01 live inference lacked mandatory allowance/current-session/account-bound catalog checks
